# Vendored

`htm-preact-3.1.1.module.js`: htm 3.1.1's `preact/standalone.module.js` (Preact with hooks, and htm's tagged
templates, in one ES module, 13 KB), from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js.
sha256 `72284e8e9079c87817145df1110f74e8a2aa040b2fc384922e18dfcb46fc1fd7`.

htm is Apache-2.0 (https://github.com/developit/htm/blob/master/LICENSE); Preact is MIT
(https://github.com/preactjs/preact/blob/main/LICENSE). Served from here, never a CDN, so the page has no build step
and no third-party script host. To update: fetch the new version's file, put its version in the name and these
lines, and change the imports in `../js/`.
